job.title: Saarbrücken Senior Consultant, SAP CX, CPQ & SAP Service Support (mfx) 66115

tailoring.headline: Senior SAP CX Consultant | SAP Commerce Cloud, Integration & API Expertise
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years delivering large-scale SAP Commerce Cloud solutions for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in Java, Spring, microservices and OCC REST APIs, with proven experience designing PIM/ERP/MDM integrations, data pipelines and production support. Skilled in techno-functional consulting, requirements analysis and AI-assisted development, ready to drive SAP CX initiatives.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Senior Consultant, SAP CX, CPQ & SAP Service Support (mfx)
cover_en.hook: I am excited by ORBIS’s focus on cutting-edge SAP CX solutions and the opportunity to shape CPQ and Service Support offerings. With over five years of SAP Commerce Cloud experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I have a proven track record of delivering complex integration and API projects.

bullets.label: Integration Design
bullets.text: At Rockwell Automation I designed and built PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines and resolved ERP-MDM integration bottlenecks, delivering seamless product data flow across global channels.

bullets.label: API Development
bullets.text: Developed and exposed OCC REST web services for headless commerce, enabling third-party storefronts and mobile apps at both Rockwell and Shell.

bullets.label: Techno-Functional Consulting
bullets.text: Worked directly with business stakeholders to translate requirements into functional specifications, user stories and acceptance criteria, driving SAP Commerce solutions that meet commercial needs.

bullets.label: Production & Support
bullets.text: Provided production support, performance tuning and CI/CD deployment cycles on SAP Commerce Cloud (CCv2), ensuring high availability and rapid issue resolution.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe, holds a valid German work permit, serving notice until 15 December 2026 and available to start 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how I can contribute to ORBIS.

cover_de.subject: Bewerbung als Senior Consultant, SAP CX, CPQ & SAP Service Support (mfx)
cover_de.hook: Die Ausrichtung von ORBIS auf innovative SAP CX-Lösungen begeistert mich, insbesondere die Weiterentwicklung von CPQ- und Service-Support-Angeboten. Mit über fünf Jahren Erfahrung in SAP Commerce Cloud bei Rockwell Automation und Shell bringe ich fundierte Expertise in Integration und API-Entwicklung mit.

bullets.label: Integrationsdesign
bullets.text: Bei Rockwell Automation habe ich PIM-zu-Hybris-Datenpipelines konzipiert und ERP-MDM-Integrationsengpässe behoben, um einen nahtlosen Produktdatenfluss über globale Kanäle zu gewährleisten.

bullets.label: API-Entwicklung
bullets.text: Ich entwickelte und stellte OCC-REST-Webservices für Headless-Commerce bereit, wodurch Drittanbieter-Storefronts und Mobile-Apps bei Rockwell und Shell integriert wurden.

bullets.label: Techno-funktionale Beratung
bullets.text: Ich arbeitete eng mit Fachbereichen zusammen, um Anforderungen in funktionale Spezifikationen, User Stories und Akzeptanzkriterien zu überführen und SAP-Commerce-Lösungen zielgerichtet zu realisieren.

bullets.label: Produktions- und Support
bullets.text: Ich verantwortete Produktionssupport, Performance-Tuning und CI/CD-Deployments auf SAP Commerce Cloud (CCv2) und stellte so hohe Verfügbarkeit und schnelle Problemlösungen sicher.

cover_de.logistics: Ich lebe in Karlsruhe, besitze eine gültige deutsche Arbeitserlaubnis, befinde mich in der Kündigungsfrist bis zum 15.12.2026 und kann ab dem 16.12.2026 starten. Ich freue mich auf ein Gespräch, um meinen Beitrag bei ORBIS zu erläutern.

tailoring.why_company: ORBIS stands out as a leading digital transformation partner that combines deep SAP expertise with innovative CX solutions. I am impressed by your recent SAP CX implementations for European manufacturers and your commitment to AI-assisted delivery, which aligns perfectly with my experience using generative AI to accelerate SAP Commerce projects. Joining ORBIS would allow me to leverage my SAP Commerce Cloud background while contributing to cutting-edge CPQ and Service Support initiatives.
tailoring.motivation_short: I want to drive SAP CX excellence at ORBIS, using my SAP Commerce Cloud expertise to deliver seamless integrations and innovative CX solutions.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m a senior SAP Commerce Cloud developer with 5+ years delivering integration-rich e-commerce solutions at Rockwell and Shell. I’m excited about the Senior Consultant SAP CX role at ORBIS and would love to discuss how I can add value.
tailoring.email_subject: Application – Senior Consultant, SAP CX, CPQ & SAP Service Support (mfx)
tailoring.email_body: Dear Hiring Team, please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Senior Consultant, SAP CX, CPQ & SAP Service Support position. With over five years of SAP Commerce Cloud experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep integration, API and techno-functional expertise. I am based in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work permit, and will be available from 16 December 2026. I look forward to speaking with you.
